title: Verify: Timed-out attempt is retried once and fails with ErrTimeout unit tests
summary: Unit tests for ErrTimeout and timeout retry
description: Add tests using fakeAgent{block:true} and a 20ms Timeout, plus a cancelled-parent case.
acceptance_criteria: Timeout with MaxRetries 1 runs agent twice and wraps ErrTimeout and DeadlineExceeded
Cancelled parent context does not wrap ErrTimeout
technical_constraints: Reuse newRunner, fakeAgent, fakeTrees from runner_test.go

steps.action: Build agent := &fakeAgent{block: true} and h := newRunner(t, Config{MaxRetries: 1, Timeout: 20 * time.Millisecond}, agent); call h.r.Run(context.Background(), "EXEC-1", "ROUND-0000001"); assert agent.calls == 2, errors.Is(err, ErrTimeout), errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded), and h.st.Get("EXEC-1").Status == store.StatusFailed.

Create ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel; cancel() immediately; use fakeAgent{block:true}, Config{MaxRetries: 0, Timeout: 5 * time.Second}; call Run with ctx and assert the error is non-nil, errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) is true and errors.Is(err, ErrTimeout) is false.
